{"id":2017818319,"question_id":4321,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month, 3 weeks","timestamp":1780203541,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2017818319/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Digit Frequency Score","memory":"9.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int digitFrequencyScore(int n) {\n        unordered_map<int , int>mp;\n        \n        while(n > 0)\n        {\n            mp[n % 10]++;\n            n /= 10;\n        }\n        \n        int sum = 0;\n        for(auto it : mp) sum += (it.first * it.second);\n        \n        return sum;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"digit-frequency-score","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2041}
